items.title: Escaping the Build Trap
items.author: Melissa Perri
items.description: The definitive book on product management strategy — how to shift from output-driven feature factories to outcome-driven product organizations. Essential B2B reading.

items.title: INSPIRED: How to Create Tech Products Customers Love
items.author: Marty Cagan
items.description: The bible of modern product management. Covers everything from product vision to team structure, with strong B2B and enterprise product sections.

items.title: The Lean Startup
items.author: Eric Ries
items.description: Foundational methodology for building products iteratively. Build-Measure-Learn loops, MVP thinking, and innovation accounting directly applicable to B2B SaaS.

items.title: Crossing the Chasm
items.author: Geoffrey A. Moore
items.description: The essential B2B technology adoption framework. Explains how to transition from early adopters to mainstream enterprise customers — a must-read for any B2B PM.

items.title: Hacking Growth
items.author: Sean Ellis & Morgan Brown
items.description: Growth hacking methodologies with concrete B2B examples. Covers PLG experiments, viral loops, and retention strategies for SaaS products.

items.title: The Mom Test
items.author: Rob Fitzpatrick
items.description: Practical guide to customer conversations. Teaches how to avoid false positives in B2B customer discovery by asking questions that surface real pain points.

items.title: Product-Led Growth
items.author: Wes Bush
items.description: The playbook for building a B2B SaaS product that sells itself. Covers freemium models, free trials, product-qualified leads, and viral loops.

items.title: Continuous Discovery Habits
items.author: Teresa Torres
items.description: A structured framework for ongoing product discovery. Opportunity solution trees, interviewing techniques, and assumption mapping for B2B contexts.

items.title: Strategic Monoliths and Microservices
items.author: Vaughn Vernon & Tomasz Jaskula
items.description: Technical architecture book for PMs working with platform teams. Helps B2B PMs understand service decomposition and API strategy from a product perspective.

items.title: Sprint: How to Solve Big Problems
items.author: Jake Knapp
items.description: Google Ventures' 5-day process for solving critical business problems through prototyping and testing with customers. Highly effective for B2B enterprise product validation.
